description: Inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8. A longer goodbye on the exhale.

name: Physiological Sigh
description: Double inhale and long exhale. Two sips of air, one long letting go.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
description: Belly breathing with a quiet chest. Let the belly be the bellows.

name: NSDR Protocol
description: Non-sleep deep rest lying down. Rest that is not quite sleep, and that is the point.

name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
description: Tense and release muscle groups in sequence. Clench the story, then put it down.

name: Guided Meditation
description: Seated or lying guided sit. A quiet room inside the day.

name: Easy Recovery Walk
description: Very easy walk for circulation. A stroll that asks nothing of the hero.

name: Easy Recovery Swim
description: Gentle continuous swim. Float more than you fight.

name: Tai Chi Slow Form
description: Slow continuous tai chi sequence. A fight that decided to be a garden.

name: Qigong Shibashi
description: Eighteen-movement qigong set. Eighteen small weathers.

name: Gentle Pilates Flow
description: Slow pilates sequence for control and breath. A precise kindness to the trunk.

name: Contrast Shower
description: Alternating warm and cool water. Two seasons in one stall.

name: Cold Plunge
description: Brief cold-water immersion. A short winter you choose.

name: Sauna Session
description: Timed heat exposure in a sauna. A small summer with a door.

name: Sleep Wind-Down
description: Screen-down, dim-light wind-down protocol. Close the book before the last page of the day.

name: Intermittent Fasting Window
description: Logged fasting window as a duration protocol. A pause in the feast so the tale can digest.

name: Open-Mouth Physiological Recovery Breath
description: Open-mouth recovery breathing after hard work. Let the fire out without another spark.
